data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provision for claims includes favourable prior year development of GBP 4.8m (2014: nil). Change in prior year provisions (6,898) 2,101 (4,797)
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2015 were GBP 18.715m. During 2015 there was a gross prior-year release of GBP 6.898m (net favourable movement GBP 4.797m after reinsurer's share of 2.101m), representing a ~36.9% reduction of opening gross claims outstanding. The movement is described in the Technical Provisions note as a change in prior year provisions and is attributed to favourable prior-year claims development. No specific named catastrophe events are identified as driving the movement in the notes.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provision for claims includes favourable prior year development of GBP 4.8m (2014: nil).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Technical provisions: Claims outstanding) prior-year column. Prior year gross movement taken from Technical Provisions note (note 17) 'Change in prior year provisions' gross column. The Claims note (note 4) reports the net favourable prior year development of GBP 4.8m; the gross and reinsurer-share figures are used for the primary prior-year movement. The small per-line prior-year development breakdown in the claims note is net of reinsurance; lob_movements therefore reflect net amounts and are indicated with lower confidence. Claims development 'triangle' in the report is limited (2014/2015 only) and not sufficient for a comprehensive triangle-based PYD calculation. No explicit named catastrophe events or other causes were identified as drivers of the gross PYD in the notes.
